title: Write unit tests for calculator.ts
description: Create Vitest unit tests for calculateProgress. Test percent calculation, per-category grouping, empty list, and all-complete scenarios.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty task list returns 0% overall and empty categories test passes
Mixed tasks return correct percent and category counts test passes
All-complete tasks returns 100% overall test passes
Per-category calculation is correct for multi-category task list test passes
All tests pass with npm test

steps.details: Create test file. Import calculateProgress. Create fixture task arrays.
Test 1: empty array → 0% overall. Test 2: [1 complete, 1 incomplete] → 50%. Test 3: all complete → 100%. Test 4: 2 config (1 done) + 2 functional (2 done) → config 50%, functional 100%, overall 75%.
Run `npm test` and verify all calculator tests pass.

technicalNotes: calculateProgress is a pure function — no mocking needed, just fixture data
